name: epistemic-skills
description: The full epistemic-discipline collection in one package: an entry point plus sixteen disciplines for recon (territory mapping: brief, initiative, and external-candidate modes), resolve (question settling: derivation, literature, and probe instruments), goal authoring, outsource repo-backed external handoff with delegate and full-transfer modes, focused perspective-taking, adversarial review, evidence-locked acceptance, decision persistence with resumption re-anchoring, mission custody (the manifest seat), open-questions clarification, and context-audit instruction hygiene, with usage guidance from epistemic and direct access to every method.
